about: Corrections to the schedule from snap.fan, checked by hand. update-schedule.mjs applies them every day. Dates are when the game's daily reset happens (12:00 PM Pacific, 11:00 AM in winter).

sf-highstakestables-oct26.desc: Deadpool's Diner is back with its high-stakes tables, plus two new top tables (Candy Cauldron and D-Maxx). The shop stays open until November 5.
